content.value: ReleaseKit provides two interfaces to the same release management functionality: a Go library for programmatic integration (used by schangelog, release-agent-team, and custom tooling) and a CLI for agents, CI pipelines, and humans. All logic lives in the library; the CLI is a thin wrapper (parse flags → call library → format output → exit). A shared command execution layer (run/) unifies all external commands (git, go, ls, gh, linters) with automatic dry-run, timeout, and audit trail support.
